name: Aeronca 15AC Sedan
summary: Aeronca's last and largest postwar design: a four-seat, strut-braced high-wing with fabric fuselage, all-metal wings and a roomy, upright cabin.

wings: High wing braced by a one-piece strut each side
engines: Single Continental (or Franklin) flat-four or flat-six in a rounded cowl
fuselage: Deep, boxy four-seat cabin with large windows
Bungee-cord main gear with a tailwheel

tellTales: Large, upright four-seat cabin under a strut-braced high wing
Fabric-covered fuselage on a tailwheel with a tall tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The Sedan has an upright boxy cabin with all-metal wings; the Stinson has a rounder cabin with a larger curved fin.
The Sedan has a fabric fuselage and a deeper cabin; the 170 has a metal fuselage and spring-steel gear.
The Sedan is a large four-seater; the Chief is a small two-seater.
The Sedan is a classic rounded fabric aircraft; the Maule has a squared, boxier fuselage and a more modern nose.
